prompts.moonlit: Use case: stylized-concept. Production background for ETC Pets living sanctuary in Emerald Arcade. Premium whimsical painted 3D game environment, polished collectible fantasy pet-game quality, emerald and antique-gold accents, no text, no UI, no characters, no pets. Wide landscape 3:2 composition, camera gently looking down at a broad unobstructed walkable ground area across the LOWER TWO THIRDS, environment concentrated in top third and far side edges. Ground must be clean continuous walking surface for tiny separate animated pets, no obstacles, holes, steps, bridges or pools in the walking foreground. Composition should also work center-cropped on portrait phones, no important object at edges. Detailed rich lighting, magical welcoming sanctuary, crisp painterly material textures. MOONLIT MARSH habitat: a tranquil nocturnal frog sanctuary. A huge pearly moon, distant dark cypress and tall reeds, softly glowing mushrooms and fireflies bordering a broad smooth mossy stone clearing. Small pools of moonlit water visible only at the FAR EDGES behind the playfield, not across central walking ground. Sapphire and teal moonlight, touches of gold, enchanting atmosphere. Lower two thirds must be broad continuous flat mossy ground with subtle silver reflections, gently grounded perspective.
